Metasoma_Stinger.description: A heavily segmented metasoma terminating in a curved, razor-sharp telson. This tail acts as a hyper-dexterous fifth limb, delivering paralyzing venom with surgical precision over obstacles.

Whip_Spider_Flagellum.description: An incredibly long, hair-thin filament tail completely devoid of venom or stingers. It serves entirely as an ultra-sensitive radar antenna, whipping through the air to detect invisible threats.
